threads.body: One area that could require some thought is whether to create the receive span when spring `@RabbitListener` is used. This decision would need to be aligned with spring kafka etc.

replies.body:
I don't think we would have a receive span in this case b/c my understanding is that this is a true push from the broker as opposed to polling of the broker.

We do have a problem with spring rabbit of capturing two consumer spans which is preexisting issue, but worsened with the double capture of metrics now.

Will follow-up on that: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/issues/19588
